artworks.title: Frontispiece for Callot's "The Mysteries of the Passion"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate wreath encircling a Latin inscription. The image features an intricately detailed wreath composed of large, flowing leaves. Interspersed among the leaves are several circular medallions, some bearing the initials "IHS" and others "M A." At the center of the drawing is a text in Latin: "VARIÆ TVM PASSIONIS CHRISTI, TVM VITÆ BEATÆ MARIÆ Virginis." At the bottom, there is an additional text enclosed within a decorative frame that reads, "Cum priv. Regis." The drawing exhibits fine lines and delicate shading.

artworks.title: Title Page for Callot's "The Calendar of Saints"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a title page for a publication. The page is titled "Les Images de Tous Les Saincts et Saintes de l'année" and includes text mentioning Jacques Callot and Israël Henriet, dedicated to the Cardinal Duke of Richelieu, printed in Paris. Below is an intricate coat of arms featuring three chevron shapes, topped with a cardinal's hat and surrounded by tassel-like ornaments, adding a heraldic element to the page. The style of the text and the detailed illustration convey formality and reverence appropriate for a religious and official text dating back to 1636.

artworks.title: Title Page for Callot's "The Small Miseries of War"
artworks.description: The image depicts an ornate plaque with elaborate borders and calligraphic text. The central focus is a decorative frame enclosing a stylized inscription in French mentioning "Jacques Callot" and "Israël Henriet." The text is elegantly written in a script-like font. The border is intricately designed with swirling, curvilinear patterns. The design includes the date "1636" at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Camp
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an encampment scene. A large tree with sprawling branches dominates the center. The scene is populated with several tents scattered across the landscape. In the foreground, there is a horse-drawn wagon and an assortment of barrels. There are various structures, such as tables and benches. Various figures are engaged in activities. The drawing is executed in fine lines.

artworks.title: Attacking Travelers on the Highway
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed scene from a low vantage point. The horizon is in the upper third of the frame, lined with densely-packed, intricately drawn trees. Fine and expressive line work with cross-hatching and detailed strokes convey texture. Figures engage in dynamic activity, including combat and gesturing. A fallen figure lies nearby. In the distance, more figures are seen against the backdrop of trees. The color palette is monochromatic, relying on light and dark lines for contrast.

artworks.title: Pillaging a Monastery
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a busy scene with a large burning building in the center, surrounded by city structures, trees, and people. The building appears to be a church and is detailed with engravings, flames, and smoke. People are seen bustling and climbing ladders around the burning structure. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic palette with fine, precise lines creating a sense of movement and urgency. The focus is on the detailed craftsmanship of the etching lines defining the architectural and human elements of the composition.

artworks.title: Ravaging and Burning a Village
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level perspective with a line of buildings in the background, including a structure with a belfry. Swirling clouds fill the sky above the buildings. In the foreground, there are figures engaged in various actions, some possibly in conflict or fleeing, along with horses pulling a cart. The scene is created using detailed etching lines, with a monochromatic color palette of black ink on a cream-colored background. Trees are depicted to the left of the scene.

artworks.title: The Peasants' Revenge
artworks.description: The scene depicted shows a landscape with various activities. The horizon is low in the composition, with a chapel at the center. Detailed line work captures the bustling scene, with a rich texture emphasizing movement. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink contrasting the ivory paper. Trees with foliage are on the right side, enriching the dynamic composition.

artworks.title: The Hospital
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with a slightly elevated perspective. The street is bustling with activity and is bordered by buildings. The horizon is low, with stone structures of varying conditions. The fine lines create a detailed texture of the buildings and people. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing light and shadow. In the foreground, there are people engaging in various activities, possibly in a marketplace or town square. Further back, an arched doorway stands out, surrounded by more buildings and architectural features. The scene conveys movement and interaction among the figures.

artworks.title: The Milkmaid
artworks.description: The image depicts a person with curly hair standing upright and facing the viewer. They are balancing a jug on their head and carrying a large basket with their right arm. The person is wearing a long dress with voluminous sleeves and an apron. In the background, there are several people, some with animals, trees, buildings, and a cloudy sky, creating a rustic backdrop.

artworks.title: The Piazza, Siena
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a festive bull event taking place in a large square surrounded by grand architecture and tall towers. The image shows a bustling scene with a central enclosed arena where a bull is being driven by several figures. Spectators fill the stands, which are drawn to resemble wooden structures. Tall buildings with colonnades and ornate facades line the perimeter of the square. The scene depicts a lively atmosphere with many individuals, including some on horseback. The words inscribed suggest an Italian location.

artworks.title: Interior of a Church
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural hall with a large gathering. The interior scene features a grandiose hall with high-arching ceilings, detailed arches adorned with intricate designs, and columns. In the distance, there is an altar or choir area where several figures are gathered. Along the sides of the hall, chairs are lined with individuals seated or standing, engaged in what seems to be a communal or ceremonial event. The drawing emphasizes the architectural elegance and intricate design of the interior space, signifying a place of significant social or religious importance.

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man standing on rocky ground holding a sword upright in his right hand with a book in his left hand. He has a halo around his head and is dressed in long robes with bare feet. The background includes a leafless tree on the left, a building with a spire on the right, and a few indistinct figures, with sparse cloud formations in the sky.

artworks.title: Priest Carrying the Holy Sacrament of the Eucharist
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.1 × 2.4 cm (1 5/8 × 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length side view of a figure standing in profile facing to the left. The person has a long cloak or robe that drapes down to their feet, with detailed vertical lines suggesting the texture of the garment. The person's head is covered with a hat or headpiece, and their facial features are subtle but suggest a profile view. The individual carries an object in their right hand, possibly a decorated staff or scepter with a complex, ornate top. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.2 × 6.7 cm (4 × 2 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring a heavenly ascension scene with figures and angels. In the artwork, a crowned figure is elevated above on a cluster of clouds, surrounded by a host of cherubic angels. Several angels are depicted playing musical instruments or in acts of adoration or flight. Below, earthly figures gather around a central altar-like structure, displaying a range of emotional postures and gestures. The border of the painting includes Latin text. The artwork is created in the style of Jacques Callot.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for the Sacred Cosmologia (Title With Astrologers)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.1 × 9.3 cm (5 9/16 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This print shows complex astronomical or astrological instruments set in an outdoor environment. Several people are gathered around a large armillary sphere, engaged in study or discussion. The people wear robes and hats, and some of them hold strange objects. The armillary sphere sits on a stone pedestal, with several tablets and scrolls around it, featuring different geometric shapes. Surrounding the scene are trees and bushes, with birds flying overhead and rabbits on the grassy ground. There are hills in the distance, with more animals walking among the trees.

artworks.title: The Fan
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an intricately detailed etching showing a bird's-eye view of a busy scene. The perspective is elevated, giving a panoramic view of the activity below. Buildings line the horizon, suggesting a cityscape, with a central spire reaching into the sky. In the distance, an arched bridge spans a body of water with boats and groups of people. The etching showcases fine, controlled lines for texture and depth, with precise engravings of figures and structures. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of gray, black, and white. An ornate frame surrounds the scene, adorned with swirling motifs and human figures.

artworks.title: The Fan
artworks.medium: etching and engraving from two pieces of laid paper pasted together
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 22.8 × 30.1 cm (9 × 11 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving viewed from a slightly elevated angle, capturing a detailed scene. In the middle, there is a cityscape with buildings and a tall spire. The sky above has light clouds. An ornate border frames the composition with a central grotesque mask at the bottom. Figures in period costumes interact in the foreground, while farther back, a crowd gathers near a river for a mock naval battle. A bridge filled with spectators spans the water. The artwork features intricate linework and textures, using a primarily brown and sepia color palette typical of historical engravings.

artworks.title: The Fan
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed illustration of a busy scene with a central event. The view is from above, showing people and carriages in an urban setting near a river with bridges. Buildings, towers, and spires are visible on the horizon. The illustration features intricate linework in shades of sepia, giving it a historical look.

artworks.title: The Catafalque of the Emperor Mathias
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate interior scene set in a grand hall. The hall is richly adorned with high vaulted ceilings, intricate decorations on the walls and columns, coffered ceiling patterns, and fabric drapery. A pyramid-like structure in the distance, possibly composed of lit candles or lights, stands out. The hall is set up for an event or ceremony, with multiple figures in elaborate clothing. An inscription at the bottom suggests a connection to a commemorative or ceremonial occasion.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed within plate mark): 24 × 19 cm (9 7/16 × 7 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is an image of an eagle perched above an ornate frame containing a pastoral scene. The eagle has outspread wings and finely detailed feathers. A decorative crown is above the eagle. Below the eagle, there is an oval frame among floral decorations and ribbons. The ribbons bear the words "IAMES" and "AVLTRE". Within the frame is a landscape scene with lions in a rocky terrain. The overall composition suggests an emblem or coat of arms, with the eagle and crown symbolizing power and authority. The engraving showcases the artist's skill in texture and form.

artworks.title: Saint Paul, Seated
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.2 × 9.4 cm (5 3/16 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a long beard and curly hair, seated with one arm outstretched and the other resting on a large book in his lap. He wears a robe that drapes over his body and extends to the ground. His expression is stern. One hand holds a staff and there are books stacked around him. In the background, there are dramatic clouds with a shaft of light shining down.

artworks.title: The Float of Mount Parnassus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.3 × 20.5 cm (5 5/8 × 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of a crowded scene with figures in classical attire gathered on jagged rock formations. The horizon is implied at the bottom, with fine lines and shading used throughout. The figures appear to be in a ceremonial gathering on the rugged landscape. The artwork is in a monochromatic palette of gray and ochre tones.

artworks.title: The Float of the Sun
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.2 × 20.5 cm (5 9/16 × 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is an image showing a large central figure holding a spherical object, surrounded by smaller figures engaging in various mythological activities. A chariot being pulled by two horses is depicted on the left. The drawing is done in a style resembling detailed, narrative compositions from the Renaissance period.
